Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps - Finovate Bank

Hi Ava / Michael -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we heard
- Primary use case: in-app assist for relationship managers to summarize customer conversations and flag next-actions.
- Key success metrics: reduce SLA for response drafts from 24h -> 2h; achieve 30% reduction in handle time for RM follow-ups.
- Technical constraints: must sit in VPC-private deployment; data residency in US; integration with their CRM webhooks.

Stakeholder map (ask)
- Economic buyer: can you confirm who owns the budget? (You mentioned CFO level)
- Security/legal: please share names for SOC2 / security intake and legal redlines so we can route docs.
- Procurement: rough timeline for PO/contracting? Any standard SOW/terms we should expect?

What I'm sending now
- Attached: stakeholder_matrix.xlsx (simple map + recommended enablement owners)
- Attached: mutual_action_plan.docx (proposed timeline + milestones)

Next steps
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and the security/legal contacts by EOD Tue 11/24?
2) We'll prep a short champion enablement pack (talk tracks + ROI bullets) and a filled security questionnaire draft for your team.
3) Propose a 30-minute enablement call next week to arm your internal champion - would Tue 11/30 or Wed 12/1 morning PT work?

If useful, I can also share a one-page ROI example tailored to RM workloads.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference - developer-first inference platform
